title: DC-area forecast: Showers and storms today and tonight. Nicer by midweek.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Humid with scattered showers and downpours today. An isolated storm could produce damaging winds or a tornado this afternoon. Mostly cloudy skies hold highs to the upper 70s to low 80s.

What’s next? A lingering dose of afternoon thunderstorms is possible on Monday. Sunshine returns in full swing Tuesday and Wednesday and it's not as humid.

Today’s daily digit — 4/10: Cloudy and humid with showers and storms. Cool temperatures well below average are a bit of a silver lining. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Sunday): Mostly cloudy skies keep temperatures in check with afternoon highs in the upper 70s to low 80s, and it's quite muggy with dew points in the low 70s. Scattered showers and downpours are with us at times throughout the day. A few gusty thunderstorms are possible in the afternoon, and an isolated storm could spawn damaging winds or a tornado, especially west and southwest of DC. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: Scattered showers and maybe a thunderstorm continue at times during the evening and overnight. A storm or two could still produce strong winds in the evening, while some pockets of heavy rain could threaten localized flooding during the evening into overnight. Some spots could end up with an inch or more of rain from today and tonight. Muggy lows in the low to mid-70s. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Monday): A cold front lingering nearby keeps the chance of a few afternoon showers and gusty storms in play. Partly sunny skies help temperatures trend warmer with highs in the upper 80s to low 90s and still plenty of humidity. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: A shower or storm chance could linger into early evening. Otherwise skies trend partly to mostly clear with lows in the upper 60s to low 70s. Confidence: High

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Plenty of sunshine Tuesday and Wednesday. Highs reach the mid-80s to near 90 as humidity steps back a bit to the moderate range. Either day could work if you are trying to squeeze in a late-summer day poolside. Confidence: Medium-High

Mostly sunny Thursday and partly cloudy Friday. Highs both days in the 80s as humidity edges a bit higher. Even though the chance of a late-day shower or storm may return, both days should be decent enough to enjoy before summer starts to run out. Confidence: Low

DC weather history for August 16

Oppressive heat in 1997 sent temperatures to 102 degrees with a heat index of 111, kicking off a two-day stretch of extreme, record-setting conditions.
